units.rawText: I know I'm not a particularly likable person, but I don't really care either.

units.rawText: Associating with shallow individuals is tiring and injurious to the spirit, much like a beast tamer in a circus must waste time on breaking in a pack of lions who don't understand human speech.

units.rawText: That said, you seem different, Professor. In your case... I guess you're like a lion that understands human speech?
